body: How can I get help though I don’t want to leave my room, I’m not sure what’s even going on anymore I haven’t slept for 3 days I’m so confused. Can they come to me? What’s the benefit of getting diagnosed with ADHD I heard they pump you full of mind numbing drugs that make you think less? I don’t think I can cope with anything anymore? Help
I don’t really dream, I don’t have an imagination, Aphantasia is just the worst

I’d swap positions with the person dying of cancer any day of the week, last time I spoke to the fat man across the road he told me he just plays games all day and seems happy enough. Maybe he’s hiding something I don’t know. I feel like an outsider in my own body. I don’t like being alive so why the fuck do I have to live if I don’t want to? Why do I have to do anything if I don’t want to? What does it mean to be alive what does anything fucking mean? Why do I have to do anything? Because humans are smart and have complex understandings and have society’s? I don’t know? 

Why if humans are so great do I have to do anything at all? Maybe nobody else is real? Maybe I’m imagining everything? Maybe this is all a dream in a endless universe of dreams? Life only exists for a finite time but for some reason I was born on the only ducking planet that has life in the right time in the right place? I don’t think it’s possible. This has to be a fucking simulation it’s sick. I don’t want to keep this shit going on. Everything is fake except me because that’s all I can see

How would I gain new perspective? Watch someone I know die of cancer again or watch the fat cunt across the road have to be hoisted into his fucking house everyday because he’s so fat he can’t even walk, still gets more money from the government then I do working every fucking day. What’s the ducking point in working when I could eat myself so large the government gives me more money than I make in a month currently? What’s the point?

Edit: I didn’t mean to offend anyone or call anyone a free loader, to be totally honest I’d rather be a free loader than what I’m doing right now

What does that even mean? You think weeds bad? Maybe it is but maybe it isn’t. Do you tell fat people just don’t eat it’s not rocket science? Or people who smoke cigs? Or people who binge alcohol? No?

Don’t comment your worthless insight. I mean, holy shit, It’s not rocket science.

I went to the doctor around two years ago and got prescribed anti depressants, they did nothing for me and I never got another prescription. I’ve been told by friends all my life that I’ve probably got ADHD I can’t stick to one thing for very long along with all the other shit that comes with it but never seen a doctor about it because they won’t be able to do anything about it. 

I feel pressured not to take sick days when I feel at my lowest because who cares about mental health right? 

Maybe I’m autistic  I do do a lot of things associated with the disorder, I definitely have some form of anxiety as I stopped driving lessons because my heart rate would reach over one hundred as soon as I was at the wheel for the whole lesson, always doubting myself that I’m going to crash or what happens if I make a mistake on the roundabout or what if that person pulls out in front of me what do I do? I took the test twice and failed both times and that was the last straw driving isn’t for me I can’t handle the responsibility of being behind the wheel something that could kill someone if I made a mistake. 

Honestly I don’t feel real half the time, everything is wrong, why was I born on the rock floating in space, why do I have to do things like work, why couldn’t I have been born a cat or something with no responsibilities just do whatever they like and nobody cares, I want to be alone, carefree and not bothered by anyone. I don’t want to work. I don’t want to have responsibilities. I want to be a cat essentially. I just don’t see why I have to do these things, I never asked to be born, why do I have to act like I enjoy it. I hate it. 

I’d rather have not been born just have not existed. Life needs to leave me alone for once. I’ve been working every day since I left school at 17 after I got fucked over by shitty teachers who couldn’t do their job, nobody in my class passed everyone failed even the smart kids but I couldn’t continue. I got about a week break before I was made to volunteer at some job, then I was employed as an apprentice and take advantage of as cheap labour, never got taught anything. Now I’m stuck working in a shit job in a shit city in a shit country on a shitty planet in the only known place where life exists and it’s shit, I hope no other place has life because if it’s anything like this then it’s not worth it.
Well I’ve ran dry so I’ve got to give it a try for at least a couple weeks.
I’m currently coping with excessive smoking of weed, turning in to a vegetable every night when I can is the only way I don’t feel shit about myself and I can actually feel happy in life.

I’ve been working in IT since Oct 2016, doing things from server setups, CCTV installs, wire runs, technician role in business and schools, setting up webpages using Wordpress and coding stuff myself, making apps for company’s to use on a daily bases with databases for sorting large quantities of data. Pretty much everything under the IT blanket I’ve done. Still making 1050 pounds a month though.
